report.explanation: All current telemetry is healthy: order checkout trace OK at 67ms, gateway/order/payment metrics show low error rate (0.0014), p95 79ms, zero pool waiters and dependency timeouts, and INFO 200 logs. No taxonomy cause (http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency, memory-leak, bad-configuration) is supported. The payment deployment record alone cannot establish latency. Insufficient evidence to name a root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Evidence of actual checkout failures or elevated latency (5xx, timeouts, p95 regression) during the alert window
Service-level error/latency breakdown isolating which checkout dependency degraded
Redis/downstream dependency latency and timeout telemetry
Memory retention time series per service to assess any leak trend
